Yes, you can use your old **700W charger** as it is fully compatible with all new Ather scooters, including the **Ather 450S**.

cases.direct_answer: FallSafe™ cuts off power to the motor when a rider falls to stop the scooter from moving further, while simultaneously blinking both indicators to alert nearby road users.
key_takeaways: Cuts off power supply to the motor in the event of a rider fall
Stops the scooter from moving further
Triggers both indicators to blink to alert fellow riders
Can be enabled or disabled via the scooter dashboard

technical_specs.Function: Motor power cutoff and hazard alert

conditions_and_safety: For your safety, the manufacturer recommends keeping the FallSafe™ feature always on.
cases.formatted_markdown:
### Understanding FallSafe™

**FallSafe™** is an advanced safety feature designed to protect you and others on the road in the unfortunate event of a fall.

#### How It Works
* **Motor Cut-off:** Automatically cuts off the power supply to the motor if the rider falls off, stopping the scooter from moving any further.
* **Road Alerts:** Both indicators start blinking simultaneously as an additional safety layer to alert fellow riders on the road.
* **User Control:** You have the flexibility to enable or disable the feature directly from the scooter dashboard.

> **Safety Recommendation:** For your safety, we strongly recommend keeping the FallSafe™ feature **always on**.

sources.title: What is FallSafe™ and how does it work?
sources.content:
What is FallSafe™ and how does it work?

FallSafe™ is a safety feature that cuts off the power supply to the motor in case the rider falls off, and stops the scooter from moving further. As an additional safety layer, both the indicators also start blinking, to alert fellow riders on the road. You can enable/disable the feature from the scooter dashboard. However, for your safety, we recommend you keep it always on.

sources.title: What are the conditions under which warranty will not be applicable on the battery?
sources.content:
What are the conditions under which warranty will not be applicable on the battery?

Damages caused due to customer negligence (except for deep discharging of battery cells due to the vehicle being in idle state). Any modifications/alterations made to the battery will void the warranty. Deletion or alteration of VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) and BIN (Battery Identification Number) would not be covered. Situations such as theft, abuse, accident, flooding, fire etc. are not covered under the plan. Battery's natural wear and tear or any physical damage in parts & conditions is also excluded...

cases.formatted_markdown:
### Eight70 Warranty: Battery Degradation Protection

The **Eight70 Warranty** is a comprehensive, industry-first warranty plan designed to protect against both battery failures and degradation, providing complete peace of mind.

#### Key Features
* **Coverage Period:** Total of **8 years or 80,000 km** (whichever comes first), extending the standard 3-year manufacturer warranty by an additional 5 years.
* **Degradation Protection:** The battery is guaranteed to stay **above 70% health** until the end of the 8th year. If health drops below 70% at any point, the battery will be replaced for free.
* **Comprehensive Defect Coverage:** Covers any and all battery defects, including cells, electrical, electronic components, and the BMS.
* **Idle State Assurance:** No claim rejections due to deep discharge of battery cells when the scooter is left uncharged or idle over an extended period.

*Note: This warranty plan is available as an add-on that can be purchased with AtherStack Pro.*
